scope: Read-only replication of fixed G1 validation and test metrics; not a new independent test, no retuning. G2 and other targets not rerun.
notes: Historical snapshot category, location and is_primary are not proven point-in-time; future-event perturbation does not remove these limitations.
Feature category levels and panel keys derived from full snapshot; eligibility depends on lagged activity.
Trend denominator in code is years y-2..y-4, numerator y-1; report wording previous3 mean is ambiguous.
Observed80% coverage is aggregate, not guarantee per district/category.
Review reruns fixed published model only; does not create a fresh holdout.
